# Aunt Atossa & Diana Barry

- [Aunt Atossa](../character/aunt-atossa.md) — Relative of — [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) — paternal grand-aunt / aunt of father · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Life P18](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0018)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and learns from Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) that [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md) is terminally ill with consumption. On their way to visit Ruby, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) stop at the Wrights' house, where [Aunt Atossa](../character/aunt-atossa.md) makes several unpleasant comments, after which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reveals to [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) her plans to write a short story. They then visit the Gillis household, finding a lively crowd and Ruby stubbornly insisting she is perfectly healthy despite her failing condition.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XI The Round of Life

_Sources: [v3 ch.Life P6](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0006), [v3 ch.Life P22](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0022), [v3 ch.Life P42](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0042), [v3 ch.Life P57](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0057)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends settle into Patty's Place alongside [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) and her cats, [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) and the [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md). Before leaving [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) faces mixed reviews about her published story and adopts a stray cat, [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), whom they fail to chloroform. Eventually, [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) arrives to chaperon the household with a relaxed attitude toward their independence.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVI Adjusted Relationships
